sasha: Quick FYI — we saw a cost spike this morning after a bunch of GPU spot interruptions in us-west-2. Thinking we should formalize a mixed-capacity node-pool playbook (spot + reserved) + clear interruption handling. Any quick wins?
ben: Short list that worked for us before: taint spot pools, run evictable workloads with tolerations, keep a small on-demand buffer, and make NTH (node termination handler) do graceful cordon+drain.
mira: Agree. Also tune cluster-autoscaler: expander=least-waste, balance-similar-node-groups=true, and increase scale-down-delay to allow drains to finish. Example CA flags I use: `--expander=least-waste --balance-similar-node-groups --scale-down-unneeded-time=20m`
ben: Sample toleration we put on training/low-priority jobs: ```tolerations:\n- key: "spot"\n  operator: "Equal"\n  value: "true"\n  effect: "NoSchedule"```
mira: And set a PriorityClass for critical jobs (inference/endpoint) so they don't get evicted from spot pools. Spot worker pods get a low priorityClassName so CA/evictions target them first.
ben: For termination flow we run AWS Node Termination Handler as a daemonset (captures 2-min IMDS notices), then run: `kubectl cordon <node>` + `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` from the handler. Works well for graceful KV cache flushes.
devops-bot: 🚨 k8s-autoscaler-bot: scaled spot-gpu-pool from 6 -> 2 (scale down) due to capacity disturbances at 2025-04-23T12:35:10Z
sasha: GPU-specific: make sure pods use PreStop to checkpoint KV cache or persist session state before SIGTERM. Example PreStop snippet: ```lifecycle:\n  preStop:\n    exec:\n      command: ["/bin/sh","-c","python /app/save_kv_cache.py --dest /mnt/checkpoints || true; sleep 30"]```
mira: Also add a podDisruptionBudget=0/1 depending on workload tolerance so CA isn't blocked. For training batch jobs, let them be evictable and requeue; for long fine-tuning we use a tiny on-demand fallback pool.
ben: Simulation/test tips: tag a node with `kubectl annotate node <n> spot-interruption=simulate` and run the termination handler locally to test cordon/drain. On AWS you can also run `aws ec2 start-instances` with the terminate API in a sandbox account. Add alerts: spot-interruption-rate > 0.05 for a region -> pg oncall.
sasha: Action items: 1) Mira to add CA flag changes + doc the taint/toleration pattern (due EOD). 2) Ben to add PreStop KV checkpoint example to infra repo. 3) Ops to set dashboard alert for spot-interruption-rate and maintain a 3-node on-demand buffer in us-west-2.
ben: will file PRs. :thumbsup:
k8s-autoscaler-bot: note: remember to label node groups with `k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled=true` and `spot=true` so CA can treat them differently.
